children.label: b
children.prompt: Find the area of the region bounded by the curve $y=e^{-x}$, the $x$-axis, the $y$-axis and the line $x=1$.

spec.description: Decreasing exponential with the area between x=0 and x=1 shaded and a dashed guide at e^{-1}.
spec.mathematics: y=e^{-x}; 0≤x≤1; y-intercept 1 and boundary height e^{-1}.
